message.content:
Explore the NINEONELABS renewal project to understand two things:

## 1. About page award section (PHP view)
- Find and read `views/pages/inside/award.php` (the standalone award page)
- Find the award section inside the about page view — likely `views/pages/about/view.php` or similar
- Look for how award data is fetched (API endpoint, controller, or fallback data pattern)
- Check `api/` directory for any award-related endpoint

## 2. Hover-to-video implementation on Works page (the reference pattern)
- Read `resource/ts/ui/WorkCard.ts` — this likely has the hover-to-video logic
- Read `resource/ts/pages/works/render/WorksSceneManager.ts` and `resource/ts/pages/works/runtime/WorksPageRuntime.ts` for context
- Understand: how is fallback data structured? how does hover trigger video? what DOM attributes/classes are used?

## 3. About page TypeScript
- Find the about page runtime/scene files in `resource/ts/pages/about/`
- Understand how the about page initializes its sections

Report:
- The exact structure of the award section in the about page view (HTML/PHP)
- How fallback data is defined for works (structure, where it lives)
- The hover-to-video mechanism in WorkCard.ts (key methods, DOM selectors, event wiring)
- Where in the about page TS the award section should hook in
- All relevant file paths and line numbers

FALLBACK DATA STRUCTURE ### Award Fallback Data (`views/pages/inside/award.php`, lines 7-15; views/pages/about/index.php`, lines 59-65) ```php $awardRows = [ [ 'year' => '2025', 'title' => 'han.com Docs AI', 'awardLabel' => 'GDWEB', 'awardIcon' => '/resource/images/logo/GDWEB.png', 'prize' => '웹사이트 부문 금상', 'detailPath' => '/works', 'previewImage' => '', // Optional hover image 'previewVideo' => '', // Optional (award.php only) - falls back to awardVideoFallbacks ], // ... more items ] ``` ### Video Fallback Array (`views/pages/inside/award.php`, lines 41-46) ```php $awardVideoFallbacks = [ '/resource/video/why_video_1.mp4', '/resource/video/why_video_2.mp4', '/resource/video/why_video_3.mp4', '/resource/video/why_video_4.mp4', ]; ``` The view cycles through these with `$awardVideoFallbacks[$awardVideoIndex % count($awardVideoFallbacks)]` (line 57). --- ## 3. HOVER-TO-VIDEO IMPLEMENTATION (WorkCard.ts reference pattern) ### WorkCard.ts Key Methods **File:** `resource/ts/ui/WorkCard.ts` #### Static Methods for Video Frame Handling: 1. **`updateTextureVideoFrame()` (lines 296-340)** - Renders a video frame onto the canvas texture - Handles video aspect ratio vs card aspect ratio (cover mode) - Called when video alpha reaches 0.99 during fade-in - **Signature:** `(texture, proj, size, video, renderOptions)` 2. **`overlayVideoFrame()` (lines 342-382)** - Blends video frame over existing image with alpha transparency - Used during fade transition (alpha interpolation) - **Signature:** `(texture, size, video, alpha)` where `alpha` ranges 0→1 3. **`updateTextureImage()` (lines 209-226)** - Resets texture back to static image - Called when deactivating hover (alpha returns to 0) ### WorksSceneManager.ts Hover Video Runtime (lines 73-171) **Class: `WorksHoverVideoRuntime`** Key state: - `_video: HTMLVideoElement` — created once in constructor (lines 83-88) - `_texture: THREE.CanvasTexture | null` — the mesh's canvas texture - `_alpha: number`, `_alphaTarget: number` — fade in/out control - `_staticImage: HTMLImageElement | null` — fallback image during fade **Activation flow (line 95-114):** ```ts activate(mesh, texture, videoUrl, proj, size, staticImage) { this._texture = texture; this._alpha = 0; this._alphaTarget = 1; // Target: fade in this._video.src = videoUrl; this._video.load(); void this._video.play().catch(() => undefined); } ``` **Draw frame (lines 121-161):** - Alpha lerp: `this._alpha += (this._alphaTarget - this._alpha) * 0.12` (12% per frame) - At 0.01 alpha: returns to static image - At 0.99 alpha: switches to direct video frame rendering - During transition (0 < alpha < 1): uses `overlayVideoFrame()` to blend **Deactivation (lines 116-119):** ```ts deactivate() { this._video.pause(); this._alphaTarget = 0; // Target: fade out } ``` ### Hover Detection & Wiring (WorksSceneManager.ts, lines 665-686) In the `update()` method: ```ts if (this.hovered !== this._prevHovered) { if (this._prevHovered) this._hoverVideo.deactivate(); GRID PAGE VIDEO HOVER (Reference for Award Implementation) **File:** `resource/ts/pages/works/runtime/WorksPageRuntime.ts`, lines 795-836 ```ts private _attachVideoHover( li: HTMLLIElement, videoUrl: string, figure: HTMLElement, ): void { const video = document.createElement("video"); video.muted = true; video.loop = true; video.playsInline = true; video.preload = "none"; figure.append(video); const show = (): void => figure.classList.add("is-video-active"); const onEnter = (): void => { if (!video.src) { video.src = videoUrl; video.load(); } void video.play().catch(() => undefined); if (video.readyState >= 3) { show(); // Already buffered } else { video.addEventListener("canplay", show, { once: true }); } }; const onLeave = (): void => { video.removeEventListener("canplay", show); figure.classList.remove("is-video-active"); video.pause(); }; li.addEventListener("pointerenter", onEnter); li.addEventListener("pointerleave", onLeave); } ``` **Key pattern:** - Lazy-load video (preload="none") - Trigger play on pointerenter - Wait for `canplay` event (readyState >= 3) before showing - Simple CSS class toggle `is-video-active` - Cleanup via `removeEventListener` --- ## 5.
